title: Operation Iron Tide
description: Break a coordinated occupation from the industrial coast to the city command sector. Ten hard-difficulty operations across eight theaters, all on 40 × 40 maps.

missions.title: Nightfall Insertion
missions.objective: Seize the hostile flag at the occupied waterfront.

missions.title: Iron Corridor
missions.objective: Rescue workers trapped among the industrial halls.

missions.title: Signal Black
missions.objective: Hold the railhead flag against the hostile counterattack.

missions.title: Dark Canopy
missions.objective: Eliminate the hostile force concealed in the woodlands.

missions.title: Runway Siege
missions.objective: Capture the enemy command flag at the airfield.

missions.title: Crossfire Junction
missions.objective: Defend the crossroads flag and keep the supply route open.

missions.title: Silent Harvest
missions.objective: Rescue the civilians under occupation at the farmstead.

missions.title: Command Collapse
missions.objective: Eliminate the hostile command force in the city blocks.

missions.title: Last Berth
missions.objective: Rescue the civilians stranded along the occupied piers.

missions.title: Iron Tide
missions.objective: Capture the final enemy operations flag to end the campaign.
